# Expofp

ExpoFP provides free interactive floor plan software for expos and conferences.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/expofp/.

## Actions

- **Add Category**: Add a new category to an expo.
- **List All Expo Extras**: List all extras for an expo.
- **List All Expos**: List all expos.
- **Remove Category**: Remove a category from an expo.
- **Update Category**: Update an existing category.
